mapper.select: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MAX(updated_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM exchange_rate

SELECT d.id AS currency_pair_definition_id, b.id AS brand_id, b.code AS brand_code, CASE WHEN cp.spread_group_id IS NOT NULL THEN sg.deposit_spread_percent ELSE bs.deposit_spread_percent END AS deposit_spread_percent, CASE WHEN cp.spread_group_id IS NOT NULL THEN sg.withdrawal_spread_percent ELSE bs.withdrawal_spread_percent END AS withdrawal_spread_percent FROM currency_pair_definition d CROSS JOIN brand b LEFT JOIN currency_pair cp ON cp.currency_pair_definition_id = d.id AND cp.brand_id = b.id LEFT JOIN spread_group sg ON sg.id = cp.spread_group_id LEFT JOIN brand_spread bs ON bs.brand_id = b.id ORDER BY d.id, b.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rate (currency_pair_definition_id, brand_id, rate, deposit_rate, withdrawal_rate, rate_minute, source) VALUES (#{currencyPairDefinitionId}, #{brandId}, #{rate}, #{depositRate}, #{withdrawalRate}, #{rateMinute}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rate = VALUES(rate), deposit_rate = VALUES(deposit_rate), withdrawal_rate = VALUES(withdrawal_rate), source = VALUES(source)
